spells.name: Wrack
spells.source: CONFIRMED mechanics: 200 mana, 6 s channel, 1 s ticks (warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Wrack, timesaver.gg); while channelling Siphon Life/Corruption/Bane of Agony tick 100% faster, durations unchanged (Blizzard hotfix 10 Nov). CONFIRMED damage rule (Blizzard beta development notes, 3 Nov: https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/raw/2360696/9): spell damage coefficient doubled to 0.286 per second; base damage per second grows by 2.5 per level, 'at level 60 effectively increased from 36 to 86' (so 36 at level 40, 86 at 60). Hotfix 10 Nov: 'Wrack damage reduced by 30%': x0.7 gives 60 per tick at level 60, which matches the 60 on the wiki and timesaver tooltips (guildorder's 124 is not explained). ASSUMPTION: the -30% applies to the coefficient too.

spells.name: Life Tap
spells.source: Wowhead Forever ids 1454,1455,1456,11687,11688,11689 give only a Dummy value (20,65,130,210,300,420); warcraft.wiki.gg Forever: rank 1 'Converts 30 Health into 30 Mana. Spirit increases the amount converted' (6 ranks, level 6). Base = value + 10 (rank 1: 30; ASSUMED for the others). The Spirit term and the conversion ratio are NOT confirmed (a guide says cost = base + Spirit and 1.2 mana per health).
